items.title: Somalia braces for El Niño floods as millions face risk of hunger
items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year.
